[Problem]{.card-kicker} **the route that must pass through K** [AC abc070_d · Transit Tree Path](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc070/tasks/abc070_d)

The required route goes from $x$ to $K$ and then from $K$ to $y$. Its length is $\mathrm{dist}(K, x) + \mathrm{dist}(K, y)$, including when the two paths share edges. One weighted BFS from $K$ answers every query.
